cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: All claims match the expected facts and are consistent with the public project description; no invented specifics.
cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF, annotate, sign, rearrange/merge pages, and download a real flattened PDF. Nothing ever leaves the browser; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen locally via **pdf.js + pdf-lib**, and it works offline once loaded.

**Highlights**
- Runs on phones (375 px), tablets (768 px), desktops (1440 px+) — mouse, pen, or touch
- No build step, no backend, no install — just open `index.html` or serve the folder
- Landing page with the Pdfroo kangaroo mascot, drag-and-drop, sample PDF, Find & Replace, Compress, and a privacy "pouch promise"
- Pages panel: thumbnail sidebar (desktop), slide-in drawer (tablet), bottom sheet (phone); drag to reorder (SortableJS), rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank, merge PDFs
- After first successful download: a friendly kangaroo toast — "Done! Your PDF never left your device. Go enjoy a coffee ☕" — no donation ask

**Tech:** JavaScript, CSS, HTML (pdf.js, pdf-lib, SortableJS)  
**Repo:** https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo (MIT)  
**Live:** https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/
